sum: Village Super Market, Inc. engages in the operation of a chain of supermarkets in the United States. The company offers grocery, meat, produce, dairy, deli, seafood, prepared food, bakery, and frozen food products. It also provides non-food products, including health and beauty care, general merchandise, liquor, and pharmacy products. The company offers its products under the Wholesome Pantry, Bowl & Basket, Paperbird, and Fairway and Gourmet Garage brands. It operates its supermarkets under the ShopRite and Fairway banners, and specialty markets under the Gourmet Garage banner; and online stores through shoprite.com, fairwaymarket.com, and gourmetgarage.com websites, as well as ShopRite app, Fairway app, and Gourmet Garage app. Village Super Market, Inc. was founded in 1937 and is based in Springfield, New Jersey.
